blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. on Friday said a remark made by the Chinese ambassador in Manila sounded “very much like a threat” that deserves a discussion between them. Chinese Ambassador Jing Quan earlier drew rebuke from the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) after saying China could “easily win” if it uses force but won’t.
